summary: Comprehensive final QA pass on the LOKAGER 60s launch ceremony (frontend-only, no backend). Full real-time end-to-end run captured every countdown number 60..0 (61 unique, none missing, ~1s dwell), all 20 scenes s0..s19 in correct order (LAND appearing at s4 and s11 is intentional per approved copy, not a bug), zero console errors/warnings, zero unhandled rejections, zero /api requests, chime produces exactly 4 oscillators at zero (none before), celebration reached at t+60.8s, coming-soon reached and remained stable +15s later, reload returns to idle. Double-tap protection works (startedAtRef guards re-entry). Legacy localStorage preseed AND storage-throwing both leave the launch button visible/functional. Responsive check across 1920/1440/1366/820/430/390 shows 0 horizontal overflow at all widths; small vertical overflow on mobile (33px @820, 18px @430, 56px @390) which is acceptable scrollable overflow, no clipping. Optional Unsplash image abort produced 0 broken glyphs; ceremony continued unaffected. Asset SHA256 for /brand/lokager-logo.webp matches bf39ce6e6e2c2f7e0991e04e422ce000367eb32013b03781064d01826afc6d4b. Only minor asset finding: /favicon.ico returns HTTP 200 with content-type text/html (CRA SPA fallback serves index.html); browsers use the explicit <link rel=icon> at /brand/lokager-logo.webp so no visible break, but /favicon.ico itself is not a valid image response.

issues: ~56px vertical overflow on the narrowest mobile viewport (page becomes scrollable). Not clipped, but a smaller mobile could feel cramped. Consider tightening header/footer paddings at sm breakpoint or reducing min-heights on SceneMessage.

http_asset_checks./favicon.ico: 200 text/html (SPA fallback - browsers use rel=icon webp instead; minor)

measurements.optional_image_abort_test: aborted photo-1544984243-ec57ea16fe25 (villa); at t+20s during countdown, phase=countdown, broken image glyphs=0, no layout collapse, no horizontal overflow. Framer Motion clip-path animation reveals blank frame if image is missing but page and ceremony remain intact.

action_items: (LOW) /favicon.ico returns HTML (SPA fallback). Add an actual /public/favicon.ico or /favicon.webp so bots/legacy clients receive a real image; the visible browser tab already uses <link rel=icon href=/brand/lokager-logo.webp> so no user-visible impact.

(LOW) Mobile 390x844 countdown page has ~56px vertical scroll. Consider trimming header/footer padding at sm breakpoint or SceneMessage min-heights to keep the ceremony fully within one viewport on the smallest phone. Not required by spec.

(LOW / code-quality) chime.js: unlockAudio() calls ctx.resume() without a .catch, and playChime() has no try/catch around tone() calls. Reproduce did NOT surface any unhandled rejection or page break during full run (chime scheduled 4 oscillators cleanly). But if AudioContext.resume() ever rejects on a locked-down browser, an unhandled rejection would appear. Cheap hardening: `ctx.resume().catch(()=>{})` and wrap tone/playChime body in try/catch.

(INFO) manifest.json only declares one 2000x751 icon. Per iteration_5 note, PWA installability audits expect 192/512 maskable square icons. Out of scope for launch ceremony; do not fabricate/crop the artwork.
critical_code_review_comments: useLaunchCeremony.start() guards re-entry with startedAtRef — verified rapid double-tap does not restart. Good.

chime.js unlockAudio: `ctx.resume()` returns a Promise that is not caught. If browser rejects (e.g. autoplay policy on locked context after gesture failure) this becomes an unhandled rejection. In our environment resume() resolved cleanly, but recommend `.catch(()=>{})` for defensive parity with the audio error paths.

SceneVisual: when a source image fails to load, the Frame still animates but shows an empty ivory area (no broken-image glyph, no layout shift). Acceptable resilience; if you want a visible placeholder, wire an to swap to LineArt.
CountdownScreen SidePanel uses `h-[min(76dvh,calc(100dvh-300px))]` and works cleanly at 1366+; keep as-is.

public/index.html: no <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico"> is declared, only the webp icon — good — but /favicon.ico is auto-requested by browsers and currently returns index.html. Add a static /public/favicon.ico or /public/favicon.webp to remove the noise.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all functional checklist items pass; minor cosmetic/asset observations only)

Chime instrumentation via monkey-patching AudioContext.prototype.createOscillator counts 4 oscillators at zero and 0 before — matches design.
